#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

const int ALPHABET_SIZE = 26;
const int INFINITY = 0x3f3f3f3f;

class CF884F {
public:
    // Edge list structures
    vector<int> nextEdge, toVertex;
    int edgeCount = 1;
    
    vector<int> fromNode, toNode, capacity, origCost, reducedCost;
    int numEdges;
    
    vector<int> adjacency, predecessor, dist, flowEdge;
    int numVertices;
    
    // Priority queue for Dijkstra
    vector<int> heap, vertexPos;
    int heapSize;
    
    CF884F() {
        // Constructor
    }
    
    void initialize() {
        nextEdge.resize(1 + numEdges * 2);
        toVertex.resize(1 + numEdges * 2);
        
        fromNode.resize(numEdges);
        toNode.resize(numEdges);
        capacity.resize(numEdges << 1);
        origCost.resize(numEdges);
        reducedCost.resize(numEdges);
        
        adjacency.resize(numVertices);
        predecessor.resize(numVertices);
        dist.resize(numVertices);
        flowEdge.resize(numVertices);
        
        heap.resize(1 + numVertices);
        vertexPos.resize(numVertices);
        
        numEdges = 0;
    }
    
    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        int edgeIndex = numEdges++;
        fromNode[edgeIndex] = u;
        toNode[edgeIndex] = v;
        capacity[edgeIndex << 1] = cap;
        origCost[edgeIndex] = cost;
        
        adjacency[u] = link(adjacency[u], edgeIndex << 1);
        adjacency[v] = link(adjacency[v], edgeIndex << 1 | 1);
    }
    
    int link(int oldHead, int newEdge) {
        nextEdge[edgeCount] = oldHead;
        toVertex[edgeCount] = newEdge;
        return edgeCount++;
    }
    
    bool compareNodes(int u, int v) {
        return predecessor[u] < predecessor[v] || 
               (predecessor[u] == predecessor[v] && dist[u] < dist[v]);
    }
    
    int getMinChild(int i) {
        int left = i << 1;
        if (left > heapSize) return 0;
        int right = left + 1;
        if (right > heapSize) return left;
        return compareNodes(heap[right], heap[left]) ? right : left;
    }
    
    void heapUp(int node) {
        int index = vertexPos[node];
        while (index > 1) {
            int parent = index >> 1;
            if (compareNodes(node, heap[parent])) {
                int parentNode = heap[parent];
                heap[vertexPos[parentNode] = index] = parentNode;
                index = parent;
            } else break;
        }
        heap[vertexPos[node] = index] = node;
    }
    
    void heapDown(int node) {
        int index = vertexPos[node];
        while (true) {
            int child = getMinChild(index);
            if (child == 0 || compareNodes(heap[child], node)) break;
            int childNode = heap[child];
            heap[vertexPos[childNode] = index] = childNode;
            index = child;
        }
        heap[vertexPos[node] = index] = node;
    }
    
    void pushToHeap(int node) {
        heap[vertexPos[node] = ++heapSize] = node;
    }
    
    int popFromHeap() {
        int node = heap[1];
        int last = heap[heapSize--];
        if (last != node) {
            vertexPos[last] = 1;
            heapDown(last);
        }
        vertexPos[node] = 0;
        return node;
    }
    
    bool dijkstra(int source, int sink) {
        fill(predecessor.begin(), predecessor.end(), INFINITY);
        predecessor[source] = 0;
        heapSize = 0;
        pushToHeap(source);
        
        while (heapSize > 0) {
            int current = popFromHeap();
            int currentDist = dist[current] + 1;
            
            for (int e = adjacency[current]; e != 0; e = nextEdge[e]) {
                int edgeIdx = toVertex[e];
                if (capacity[edgeIdx] > 0) {
                    int revEdge = edgeIdx ^ 1;
                    int neighbor = current ^ fromNode[edgeIdx >> 1] ^ toNode[edgeIdx >> 1];
                    int newCost = predecessor[current] + ((edgeIdx & 1) == 0 ? reducedCost[edgeIdx >> 1] : -reducedCost[edgeIdx >> 1]);
                    
                    if (predecessor[neighbor] > newCost || 
                        (predecessor[neighbor] == newCost && dist[neighbor] > currentDist)) {
                        if (predecessor[neighbor] == INFINITY) {
                            pushToHeap(neighbor);
                        }
                        predecessor[neighbor] = newCost;
                        dist[neighbor] = currentDist;
                        flowEdge[neighbor] = edgeIdx;
                        heapUp(neighbor);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return predecessor[sink] != INFINITY;
    }
    
    int augmentPath(int source, int sink) {
        while (sink != source) {
            int edgeIdx = flowEdge[sink];
            int revEdge = edgeIdx ^ 1;
            capacity[edgeIdx]--;
            capacity[revEdge]++;
            sink ^= fromNode[edgeIdx >> 1] ^ toNode[edgeIdx >> 1];
        }
        return 1;
    }
    
    int minCostMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        // Johnson's potential initialization
        fill(predecessor.begin(), predecessor.end(), INFINITY);
        predecessor[source] = 0;
        
        for (int e = 0; e < numEdges; e++) {
            int u = fromNode[e], v = toNode[e];
            if (predecessor[u] != INFINITY) {
                predecessor[v] = min(predecessor[v], predecessor[u] + origCost[e]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int e = 0; e < numEdges; e++) {
            int u = fromNode[e], v = toNode[e];
            if (predecessor[u] != INFINITY && predecessor[v] != INFINITY) {
                reducedCost[e] = origCost[e] + predecessor[u] - predecessor[v];
            } else {
                reducedCost[e] = origCost[e];
            }
        }
        
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (dijkstra(source, sink)) {
            totalFlow += augmentPath(source, sink);
            
            for (int e = 0; e < numEdges; e++) {
                int u = fromNode[e], v = toNode[e];
                if (predecessor[u] != INFINITY && predecessor[v] != INFINITY) {
                    reducedCost[e] += predecessor[u] - predecessor[v];
                }
            }
        }
        
        int totalCost = 0;
        for (int e = 0; e < numEdges; e++) {
            totalCost += capacity[e << 1 | 1] * origCost[e];
        }
        return totalCost;
    }
    
    void solve() {
        int n;
        cin >> n;
        n = n / 2;
        numVertices = 1 + n + ALPHABET_SIZE + 1;
        numEdges = n + n * ALPHABET_SIZE + ALPHABET_SIZE;
        initialize();
        
        string s;
        cin >> s;
        vector<int> values(n * 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
            cin >> values[i];
        }
        
        // Connect source to left positions
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            addEdge(0, 1 + i, 2, 0);
        }
        
        // Connect positions to letters
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = n * 2 - 1 - i;
            int charI = s[i] - 'a';
            int charJ = s[j] - 'a';
            
            for (int letter = 0; letter < ALPHABET_SIZE; letter++) {
                int val;
                if (letter == charI && letter == charJ) {
                    val = max(values[i], values[j]);
                } else if (letter == charI) {
                    val = values[i];
                } else if (letter == charJ) {
                    val = values[j];
                } else {
                    val = 0;
                }
                addEdge(1 + i, 1 + n + letter, 1, -val);
            }
        }
        
        vector<int> letterCounts(ALPHABET_SIZE, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
            int ch = s[i] - 'a';
            letterCounts[ch]++;
        }
        
        // Connect letters to sink
        for (int letter = 0; letter < ALPHABET_SIZE; letter++) {
            addEdge(1 + n + letter, numVertices - 1, letterCounts[letter], 0);
        }
        
        cout << -minCostMaxFlow(0, numVertices - 1) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF884F solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
